opening.argument: The video warns viewers about alleged pump-and-dump activity involving Luna Classic; it does not promote buying the token or ask for money or personal data. The speaker describes groups drawing followers toward a prediction that the token will return to $1, then directly rejects that prediction. He questions whether Luna Classic can reach $1 and explains that its large token supply makes that valuation implausible. The closing caution reinforces the point: viewers are being warned about the claimed scheme, not urged to participate in it.
